claims.text: For a trip in the next few months, plan to pay with cash, a paper ticket, or a Meridian Card rather than a Harbour card.

An earlier industry

claims.text: An earlier industry estimate put the number of active Meridian Cards at 1.9 million.

evidence.quote: Tried tapping my Harbour card at the Northline gangway on Tuesday. Declined twice.
Staff at the quay said the link is not switched on yet

claims.text: Travellers report Harbour cards being declined at the Northline gangway in December 2025 and again in February 2026.

evidence.quote:
Harbour Transit is not on the live
list above, and Harbour cards cannot currently be used to pay a fare on a Northline service.

claims.text: Harbour Transit is not on Northline's live interoperability list, and a Harbour card cannot be used to pay a fare on a Northline service as of 12 February 2026.

evidence.quote:
Calder Transit, live since 4 August 2025
- Vantis Rail, live since 19 November 2025

claims.text: The only partner schemes live for cross-border tap-and-go on Northline services are Calder Transit and Vantis Rail.

evidence.quote: There are 1.4 million active Meridian Cards in circulation as of 12 February 2026.

claims.text: Northline reports 1.4 million active Meridian Cards in circulation as of 12 February 2026.

evidence.quote: The agreement covers forty-two terminals across the two networks.

claims.text: The signed agreement covers forty-two terminals across the two networks.

evidence.quote:
the Meridian tap works
fine on every route I have taken this year

claims.text: The same travellers report that Meridian card taps work on the routes they used.

evidence.quote: Neither party is announcing a date for passenger availability.

claims.text: Neither operator has announced a date for passenger availability.

evidence.quote:
have signed an agreement that enables

claims.text: Trade reporting describes the January 2026 agreement as enabling Harbour cards to be used for fare payment on Northline coastal services.

evidence.quote:
signed an agreement covering fare
interoperability between the Harbour card and Northline coastal ferry services

claims.text: Northline Ferries and the Harbour Transit Authority signed a fare interoperability agreement on 3 January 2026.

claims.text: Paper tickets and cash remain available at every Northline terminal counter and at the quayside machines.
